findings.runtimeModel: Shared typed action/state validation and transition kernel exists, but each registered lab still has bespoke action/state/validator/runtime modules. VirtualLab payloads provide a separate procedure/observation data path.
findings.learnerActionCapture: Typed runtime actions are processed in-memory/client runtime; durable LabSession stores observations, conclusions, provisional score, completion, and teacher feedback. Action-by-action trace is not durably modeled in LabSession.
findings.evidence: Plan route emits LearningEvent; session completion emits RAW_OBSERVATION or PROVISIONAL plus AuditLog. This is not yet a governed lab evidence binding to a released concept/item.
findings.mastery: Current student session route forcibly keeps masteryUpdated=false. Existing governed authority explicitly prevents a client lab score from updating mastery. A richer simulation-to-mastery event contract is designed but not implemented.

modalities.twoD: SUPPORTED by 2d_simulation definitions/components and data-driven simulation schema
modalities.threeD: NOT IMPLEMENTED; schema is future/planned and docs state no real 3D runtime

findings.learnPracticeAssessmentReuse: PARTIAL_RUNTIME_SUPPORT; lesson-embedded panels and lab pages exist, but no single versioned simulation definition is the shared executable source across Learn, Practice, and controlled Assessment.
findings.offline: PARTIAL_RUNTIME_SUPPORT; drafts and pending submissions can queue, fallback components exist, but P5-E explicitly keeps mastery events and simulation state NOT_SUPPORTED_OFFLINE.
findings.teacherVisibility: SUPPORTED for scheduled LabSession GET/review, teacher feedback, and dashboard counts.
findings.safety: PARTIAL_RUNTIME_SUPPORT; VirtualLab and pseudo-lab contracts carry safetyNotes/material/risk fields, but typed action definitions do not encode a uniform safety policy gate.
findings.scale: PARTIAL_RUNTIME_SUPPORT; data-driven procedure labs can scale through payloads, while interactive labs require code registration and bespoke state/action modules. A governed reusable definition contract is still needed.
findings.duplicateEngineDecision: Do not create a second engine. Extend lib/labs/runtime and converge VirtualLab/simulation definitions onto one versioned definition contract.
